Blank is 'trigger' - the screen is the trigger for the pain. Other options don't fit: pattern/source/screen would be redundant or semantically wrong
'in conflict with' is the collocation. pain/information/anger don't form valid collocations with 'in ___ with'
'sensory trigger' - closes eyes = removes one of his senses (vision). 'sensory' connects to 'senses' in prior sentence
ran across = came across = encountered = found by chance
acuity = sharpness/keenness. visual acuity = visual sharpness
despises = loathes = detests = intensely dislikes
recovered(got better) opposite is worsened(got worse). improved/progressed/stabilized are not true opposites
unconsciously(without awareness) opposite is deliberately(intentionally/on purpose). instinctively/automatically/habitually are similar to unconsciously

'to feel an intense dislike or contempt' = despise. admire/ignore/tolerate don't match
when + V-ing structure. 'when using his right index finger' - gerund after conjunction when with subject omitted
while + V-ing structure. 'while researching' - present participle after while with subject omitted
closing his eyes 'cuts out' the source - cuts out=eliminates/removes the information source
